# pve_sdn_ipam_status (Data Source)

IP address mappings tracked by one SDN IPAM backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_ipam_status" "example" {
ipam = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipam` (String) The SDN ipam object identifier.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster/sdn/ipams/{ipam}/status (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `id` (String) Identifier: <ipam>.
